rules.title: Nullable reference types
rules.text: Enable nullable reference types and treat warnings as errors.

rules.title: Async all the way
rules.text: Use async/await end to end, never .Result or .Wait(), and pass CancellationToken.

rules.title: Built-in dependency injection
rules.text: Use constructor injection with the built-in DI container.

rules.title: Records for DTOs
rules.text: Use records for immutable data transfer objects.

rules.title: Options pattern
rules.text: Bind configuration with the options pattern and validate it on startup.
